title: SnapshotRunIndex
description: The snapshot's run index (`runs.json`): a flat array of run summaries, newest first. Enough for the gallery's cards and its client-side filter (by test case, harness, model) without fetching every per-run file; the site fetches full records lazily per run page.

subject.description: The run's subject, verbatim from the run record.

caseName.description: The case display name, denormalized from case metadata for cards.

metrics.description: The run's metrics, verbatim from the run record.

validationLoaded.description: validation.loaded — the primary signal on the card.

state.description: status.state, verbatim from the run record.

rating.description: The run's aggregate overall rating — the worst across every domain of every review — shown as a per-run badge.

reviewCount.description: How many reviews the run carries. At least one (only published runs appear here, and publishing requires a review). The site computes the run's aggregate score (the average across reviews) from the per-run file's reviews array; this count lets a card note how many reviewers contributed.
